angle: Movement translation, DL (clearest of five groups screened, Fig 2C): each lineman's tracked Combine 40 start (combine_frames) compared with his own random NFL pass-rush starts (game_frames_sample) through five per-player similarity scores; translation does not explain pressure beyond pick (TOST at +/-1 pressure-rate pt per sd). Agreement between the official 40 and the NFL first step ('Both') becomes a pick-gap tiebreak rule.
metric_name: First step (speed 0.3-0.5 s after first movement, sd after weight and role) and the 'Both' rule (NFL first step top third AND official 40 top half, held-out cut-offs); decision rule: same class and role, back the later-picked Both rusher unless the other went more than 64 picks earlier
headline_number: Translation: no similarity score's held-out estimate exceeds 0.3 pressure-rate pts per sd beyond pick; 4 of 6 Combine-side measures (3 of 5 similarity scores plus the tracked start) equivalent to zero within +/-1 pt (TOST p <= 0.007); the two curve-level scores not shown (p 0.06, 0.10). Both list beats the pick/weight/role forecast 8 of 10 vs 16 of 59 (gap 53 [28, 75]; 44-62 across 7 sensitivity variations). Tiebreak: later-picked Both rusher wins 19 of 24 same-class/role pairs within 64 picks (error 21% [4, 36]; label shuffle p 0.02) vs earlier-pick default 54%; held-out threshold: 20 vs 14 correct of 39 (+15 pts [-15, 52]). Back-test vs pick-only list on raw pressure: 6 of 10 each, at median pick 78 vs 18.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_16/cand_3 (8.19, best recent score on this angle), applying round-18 judges' top_changes by analogy. (1) The translation question gets a formal answer: all five per-player similarity scores through one held-out slope test with TOST at +/-1 pt per sd (new Table 1). (2) Decision rule with explicit pick-gap threshold, break-even (126 picks, logistic), observed error rate with rusher-clustered interval, label-shuffle p, and leave-one-class-out threshold back-test against the 'always earlier pick' baseline (new Fig 4B). (3) Leave-one-class-out back-test of the Both list against a same-size pick-only list on raw pressure (honest tie: Both finds the same production ~2 rounds later). (4) Sensitivity table for cut-offs and pool thresholds (Table 4). (5) Single unit (pressure-rate points per sd) in the lede and text; 2026 table trimmed to 6 rows with first-step margin per name and a 'what flips each name' paragraph. (6) Cut: snap-mechanism figure (odds ratio kept in one sentence), Johnson/Jean-Baptiste illustration, frozen-pairs panel, long appendix; check.py 1,897 words, 4 figures + 4 tables.
open_risks: Held-out tiebreak gain is +15 pts with an interval crossing zero (-15, 52); the 64-pick threshold was chosen on all classes (held-out choices ranged 64-200).
On raw pressure the Both list ties a pick-only list (6 of 10 each); the value claim rests on draft price (median pick 78 vs 18) and the forecast-relative hits.
Two curve-level similarity scores do not pass TOST at +/-1 pt (p 0.06, 0.10); the margin was set by the author at roughly the official 40's value.
Pairs share rushers (10 Both rushers; Yasir Abdullah carries most losses); continuous held-out R2 of the first step is negative (-0.11).
The two-signal form was chosen after seeing all three classes; the 2026 pre-registration (hash e3079960bd2d) is the first blind test, with 32% power at half the observed gap.
